title: 第2293章 二灵战古目第2292章 书香门第
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【视线重新变化，你已是发现自己无意中感应到的这个地方，正有一片竹林。
而你的神识也是到了这里，被竹林外的什么东西阻隔，再无法继续深入。
【神识被阻隔其实并不常见，但这种突然的伤害，乃至伤害到你本尊的情况你还是除开他人主动攻击外的首次。
人都对自己的第一次印象深刻，所以这竹林也难得使你对它产生了兴趣……回身望去，你已是将苍灵的情况探知清楚，发现他还需要好一段时间才能修整好时，你起身花了点时间将渊底的一千五百多道禁制，布置出来了你挑选的三百五十道。
因地制宜，这三百五十道禁制在这样的环境下布置迅速，且能起到你想要的效果，可以短时间保护你离开后的苍灵……】
【同年两个多月后，替你靠近竹林探路的寸霞鎏壶元灵将你的分身投影引来，让你的分身顺利靠近了竹林。
近身观察，你能够看到的东西便更多，不再有遥远距离下神识的限制。
而这一看，你便心下一惊。
因为在竹林内有一个小位面，且里面有一座气息明显不一样的洞府。
洞府内虽然没有感受到什么生灵的波动，可整个洞府内的生态依旧能自如运转。
其中，便有你十分感兴趣的药园、果园、以及一处不大，但却布满雕刻印记的小号制傀房……】
【万衍千寻施展，耗时两日时间你方才有了第一个有效信息，也让你清楚竹林附近并非完全没有人靠近。
虽然里面看着生人活动的痕迹不多，像是早就无人居住的环境，只里面的许多布置自然运行。
可在竹林之外，至少在近些时间里不是只有你一位客人至此。
他们未能进入到竹林内部的小位面之中，但却尝试着进入，细微的痕迹在你万衍千寻神能的探查下纤毫毕现。
顺着这新的痕迹，你再次开始推演，并同时将洞虚金眸使用到超负荷的地步，紫意开始在你的眸边游离，也让你一心二用，于推演时视线前移，向着新发现的踪迹前方看去……】
【也就在你分身的探查即将到达极限时，你的视野内终于出现了活物……“不，并不能说是活物！”
你不是制傀师，但你接触的傀儡不少，修炼至今也亲手创造了不少类似傀儡一样的东西。
尽管你控制的傀儡不是尸傀这种死物新生，就是活人受制，很少是用材料炼制而成，用外物驱动的……但不管怎么说，你对傀儡一道不是全无知，所以在见到这位小女娃时，直接就能意识到她并不是真正的活灵。
不过为了能够完全确定，你没有急着靠近，而是更加小心的观察了起来。
也就在快到半刻钟的时间时，你才终于肯定。
你所发现的这个女娃，便是傀儡中的一种用极为高超的技艺“伪道生元契”
所炼制出来的。
此道名气极大，纵观历史的不同节点皆有能人辈出，也是你在时序祖地许多不同的残缺记忆里，都有了解的原因。
【这门以术法为纽带而施展的契约术，相当残忍，但真正成功后，所创造出来的傀儡也将十分不凡……而追求这门术法，想要被有会“伪道生元契”
content_en:
[Your vision changes again. You have discovered that there is a bamboo forest in the place you accidentally sensed.
And your consciousness has also arrived here, blocked by something outside the bamboo forest, and can no longer go deeper.
[It is actually not common for your spiritual consciousness to be blocked, but this kind of sudden injury, even hurting your own self, is the first time for you except for others to actively attack.
Everyone is deeply impressed by their first time, so it is rare for this bamboo forest to make you interested in it... Looking back, you have already found out Cangling's situation clearly, and found that it will take a while to repair it. You got up and spent some time to restrain the more than 1,500 prohibitions at the bottom of the abyss and arrange the 350 you selected.
According to local conditions, these 350 restrictions can be quickly deployed in such an environment, and can have the effect you want, and can protect Cangling after you leave in a short time...]
[More than two months later in the same year, Cunxia Luohu Yuanling, who helped you approach the bamboo forest, attracted the projection of your clone, allowing your clone to approach the bamboo forest smoothly.
By observing up close, you can see more things, and there is no longer the limitation of spiritual consciousness at a distance.
And when you saw it, you were shocked.
Because there is a small plane in the bamboo forest, and there is a cave with an obviously different atmosphere.
Although no fluctuations of life were felt in the cave, the ecology of the entire cave was still functioning smoothly.
Among them, there are medicine gardens, orchards that you are very interested in, and a small puppet making room that is not big but full of carved marks...]
[Wanyan Qianxun used it. It took two days for you to get the first effective information, and it also made you aware that there was not no one near the bamboo forest.
Although there are not many traces of human activity inside, it looks like it has been an uninhabited environment for a long time. Only many of the arrangements inside operate naturally.
But outside the bamboo forest, at least in recent times, you are not the only guest here.
They failed to enter the small plane inside the bamboo forest, but they tried to enter, and the subtle traces were revealed under the exploration of your Wanyan Qianxun divine power.
Following this new trace, you started to deduce again, and at the same time, you used the Dongxu Golden Eyes to the point of overload. The purple intention began to swim around your eyes, allowing you to focus on two things. During the deduction, you moved your eyes forward and looked towards the front of the newly discovered trace...]
[Just when your clone's exploration was about to reach its limit, a living thing finally appeared in your field of vision... "No, it can't be said to be a living thing!"
You are not a puppet maker, but you have come into contact with a lot of puppets, and you have created many puppet-like things with your own hands so far.
Although the puppets you control are either reborn as dead creatures like corpse puppets, or are controlled by living people, and are rarely made of materials and driven by external objects... But in any case, you are not completely ignorant about puppets, so when you see this little girl, you can directly realize that she is not really alive.
However, in order to be completely sure, you did not rush closer, but observed more carefully.
It was only when half an hour was approaching that you were finally sure.
The girl you discovered is one of the puppets who uses extremely superb skills to "pseudo-Tao Sheng Yuan De"
Refined.
This path is extremely famous. Throughout history, talented people have appeared in large numbers at different points in history. This is why you understand it in many different incomplete memories of the Chronological Ancestral Land.
[This contract technique that uses magic as a link is quite cruel, but when it is truly successful, the puppets created will also be very extraordinary... And pursuing this technique, if you want to be "pseudo-Dao-born Yuan Contract"
